description: As the requester, sign a child grant with this server's authority key: a data-log creation grant under your authority log (named by your authority grant, FORESTRIE_AUTHORITY_GRANT), naming the performer's log key (by default this server's own) and sized with maxHeight, the batch ceiling canopy prices it by. Saves the grant under a fresh child log id; nothing is sent. Call register_grant next.

grantee.description: base64 of the 64-byte x‖y the grant names (the performer's log key); defaults to this server's own log key, for a self-purchase

logId.description: the child data log to create; a fresh random UUID by default

maxHeight.description: the grant's batch ceiling. canopy prices a payment-gated child grant as its unit price × maxHeight, so size it to the work it is for

parentGrant.description: your authority grant: the completed grant that created your authority log and names this server's authority key, as base64 or a file path; falls back to FORESTRIE_AUTHORITY_GRANT

name: issue_grant
title: Issue a child grant as the requester
